population.span: we enrolled adults (≥18 years of age) with severe Covid-19 pneumonia, as confirmed by positive polymerase-chain-reaction (PCR) assay of any body fluid and evidenced by bilateral chest infiltrates on chest radiography or computed tomography.

endpoint.span: In the safety population, serious adverse events occurred

estimate.span: In the safety population, serious adverse events occurred in 103 of 295 patients (34.9%) in the tocilizumab group and in 55 of 143 patients (38.5%) in the placebo group.

analysis_set.span: Safety was assessed in the population that included all the patients who had received a dose of tocilizumab or placebo, according to the trial agent that was first received.

treatment_strategy.span: Eligible patients were randomly assigned in a 2:1 ratio to receive a single intravenous infusion of tocilizumab (at a dose of 8 mg per kilogram of body weight, with a maximum dose of 800 mg) or placebo plus standard care

follow_up.span: In the safety population, adverse events were reported in 77.3% of 295 patients in the tocilizumab group and in 81.1% of 143 patients in the placebo group through day 28 (<xref rid="t3" ref-type="table">Table 3</xref>); serious adverse events were reported in 34.9% and 38.5%, respectively.

absent_reason.ci: No confidence interval for the between-arm serious-adverse-event effect is stated in any held source. The reported confidence intervals concern other endpoints.

served_mismatch: The served counts match the source, but served_row.analysis_set incorrectly labels them modified intention-to-treat. These serious-adverse-event counts use the safety population grouped by trial agent first received.

candidate_rejections.span: In the safety population, serious adverse events occurred in 103 of 295 patients (34.9%) in the tocilizumab group and in 55 of 143 patients (38.5%) in the placebo group.
candidate_rejections.why: Reject the candidate's modified intention-to-treat attribution; retain these counts as safety-population results.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The trial enrolled adults with severe COVID-19 pneumonia who were hospitalized, within the question's hospitalized adult population.
entry_population_matches_question.span: we randomly assigned patients who were hospitalized with severe Covid-19 pneumonia

notes: OTHER denotes the missing endpoint-specific CI despite available full text and explicit arm-level counts; it does not reject the trial. No OR or CI was calculated or inferred. Extraction follows the served serious-adverse-events outcome, rather than the question's mortality endpoint. All spans use full text. A second dose of tocilizumab or placebo was permitted 8 to 24 hours after the first dose.
